title: harry7557558/spirula-studio
title_zh: 3D Gaussian Splatting 训练器 Spirula Studio

paragraphs.en: Cross-vendor 3D Gaussian Splatting trainer - video to splat to mesh, Vulkan or CUDA.
paragraphs.zh: 跨供应商的 3D 高斯泼溅训练器——从视频到 splat 再到网格，支持 Vulkan 或 CUDA。

paragraphs.en: Download • Build from Source • Gallery • Web Viewer
paragraphs.zh: 下载 • 从源码构建 • 画廊 • 网页查看器

paragraphs.en: Spirula Studio trains 3D Gaussian Splatting models – from raw photo/video to splat to textured mesh – in one self-contained binary. No Python/PyTorch, no separate COLMAP install. Runs on NVIDIA, AMD, Intel, and Apple GPUs via Vulkan, trains 10M full-SH Gaussians in 8 GB VRAM, and has native support for fisheye and 360° cameras.
paragraphs.zh: Spirula Studio 训练 3D Gaussian Splatting 模型——从原始照片/视频到 splat 再到带纹理的网格——全部在一个独立的二进制文件中完成。 无需 Python/PyTorch，也无需单独安装 COLMAP。 通过 Vulkan 可在 NVIDIA、AMD、Intel 和 Apple GPU 上运行，在 8 GB 显存中训练 1000 万个带完整球谐系数的 Gaussian，并原生支持鱼眼相机和 360° 相机。

sents.en: Spirula Studio trains 3D Gaussian Splatting models – from raw photo/video to splat to textured mesh – in one self-contained binary.
sents.zh: Spirula Studio 训练 3D Gaussian Splatting 模型——从原始照片/视频到 splat 再到带纹理的网格——全部在一个独立的二进制文件中完成。

sents.en: No Python/PyTorch, no separate COLMAP install.
sents.zh: 无需 Python/PyTorch，也无需单独安装 COLMAP。

sents.en: Runs on NVIDIA, AMD, Intel, and Apple GPUs via Vulkan, trains 10M full-SH Gaussians in 8 GB VRAM, and has native support for fisheye and 360° cameras.
sents.zh: 通过 Vulkan 可在 NVIDIA、AMD、Intel 和 Apple GPU 上运行，在 8 GB 显存中训练 1000 万个带完整球谐系数的 Gaussian，并原生支持鱼眼相机和 360° 相机。

paragraphs.en: Dataset credit: Garage by Simon Bethke (CC BY-SA 4.0); Flight Systems and Control Lab at UTIAS; MegaDepth-X; Mip-NeRF 360.
paragraphs.zh: 数据集来源：Garage，作者 Simon Bethke（CC BY-SA 4.0）；UTIAS 的飞行系统与控制实验室（Flight Systems and Control Lab）；MegaDepth-X；Mip-NeRF 360。

paragraphs.en: Cross vendor support via Vulkan compute – Runs on NVIDIA, AMD, Intel, and Apple GPUs
paragraphs.zh: 通过 Vulkan 计算实现跨供应商支持——可在 NVIDIA、AMD、Intel 和 Apple 的 GPU 上运行

paragraphs.en: One strategy combining advantages of MCMC/IGS+/MRNF – Sharper results, fewer floaters, from objects to large scenes
paragraphs.zh: 结合 MCMC/IGS+/MRNF 优势的一种策略——更锐利的结果、更少的漂浮物，从物体到大型场景

paragraphs.en: Extreme VRAM efficiency with quantized training – Up to 10 million SH3 Gaussians in 8GB VRAM
paragraphs.zh: 极致显存效率的量化训练——8GB 显存可支持多达 1000 万个 SH3 高斯体

paragraphs.en: Native 360° camera and equirectangular support – Load a dataset and train, no undistortion needed
paragraphs.zh: 原生 360° 相机与等距柱状投影支持——加载数据集并训练，无需去畸变

paragraphs.en: Modified Bilateral grid and PPISP for exposure/WB correction – Improving quality without unwanted color shift or darkening
paragraphs.zh: 改进的双边网格与PPISP用于曝光/白平衡校正——在不产生不必要色偏或变暗的情况下提升画质

paragraphs.en: Built-in lightning-fast SfM , AI masking , frame extraction from videos – No need to wait for COLMAP or run separate scripts
paragraphs.zh: 内置闪电般的快速 SfM、AI 遮罩、视频帧提取——无需等待 COLMAP 或运行单独的脚本

paragraphs.en: Depth/normal, meshing, skybox, linear color... And more.
paragraphs.zh: 深度/法线、网格化、天空盒、线性颜色……以及更多。

paragraphs.en: September 23, 2026: Editing and rendering features – Editing features for 3DGS models, sparse reconstructions, meshes, and masks have been added, along with support for exporting image and video renders.
paragraphs.zh: 2026年9月23日：编辑与渲染功能 – 新增了针对 3DGS 模型、稀疏重建、网格和遮罩的编辑功能，并支持导出图像和视频渲染。

paragraphs.en: September 10, 2026: Metric scale – The dataset creation module now uses telemetry metadata in common video and image formats to recover metric scale and orientation, addressing the popular report that reconstruction results are too large/small or tilted.
paragraphs.zh: 2026年9月10日：度量尺度 – 数据集创建模块现在利用常见视频和图像格式中的遥测元数据来恢复度量尺度和方向，解决了大量用户反馈的重建结果过大/过小或倾斜的问题。

paragraphs.en: September 3, 2026: LoMa feature support – The SfM module now supports LoMa for feature detection and matching on difficult datasets.
paragraphs.zh: 2026年9月3日：LoMa 特征支持 – SfM 模块现已支持使用 LoMa 在困难数据集上进行特征检测与匹配。

paragraphs.en: August 14, 2026: macOS support – Support for training on macOS/Apple Silicon has been validated. The app can now be downloaded from Releases page .
paragraphs.zh: 2026年8月14日：macOS 支持——已验证在 macOS/Apple Silicon 上进行训练的支持。 现在可以从 Releases 页面下载该应用了。

paragraphs.en: Binaries for Windows, Linux, and macOS can be downloaded from Releases page . Simply select the one for your platform, download and unzip, and double click to open the GUI.
paragraphs.zh: Windows、Linux 和 macOS 的二进制文件可从 Releases 页面下载。 只需选择适合你平台的版本，下载并解压，然后双击打开图形界面即可。

paragraphs.en: If you are training on remote/cloud GPUs, you may use the CLI – Run spirula --help for details. By default, spirula train command will serve a viewer on an HTTP port, one you can forward over ssh and view training progress in your web browser.
paragraphs.zh: 如果你在远程/云端 GPU 上进行训练，可以使用命令行界面——运行 spirula --help 查看详情。 默认情况下，spirula train 命令会在一个 HTTP 端口上启动查看器，你可以通过 SSH 进行端口转发，并在网页浏览器中查看训练进度。

paragraphs.en: To build from source, Spirula Studio provides two backends:
paragraphs.zh: 要从源码构建，Spirula Studio 提供了两个后端：

paragraphs.en: Vulkan (Recommended): The cross-platform and cross-vendor option. Most tested. Works on all major GPUs. Faster to build and produces smaller binary.
paragraphs.zh: Vulkan（推荐）：跨平台、跨厂商的选项。测试最充分。支持所有主流 GPU。 构建更快，生成的二进制文件更小。

sents.en: Vulkan (Recommended): The cross-platform and cross-vendor option. Most tested. Works on all major GPUs.
sents.zh: Vulkan（推荐）：跨平台、跨厂商的选项。测试最充分。支持所有主流 GPU。

sents.en: Faster to build and produces smaller binary.
sents.zh: 构建更快，生成的二进制文件更小。

paragraphs.en: CUDA: Legacy option for CUDA-capable NVIDIA GPUs.
paragraphs.zh: CUDA：支持 CUDA 的 NVIDIA GPU 的旧版选项。

paragraphs.en: Both provide the same training and meshing functionality. CUDA backend may be faster or slower than Vulkan depending on GPU driver, with difference generally within a few percents. Vulkan backend can be slightly more VRAM efficient in some cases.
paragraphs.zh: 两者提供相同的训练和网格化功能。 CUDA 后端可能比 Vulkan 更快或更慢，具体取决于 GPU 驱动，差异通常在几个百分点以内。 在某些情况下，Vulkan 后端的显存效率可能略高一些。

sents.en: Both provide the same training and meshing functionality.
sents.zh: 两者提供相同的训练和网格化功能。

sents.en: CUDA backend may be faster or slower than Vulkan depending on GPU driver, with difference generally within a few percents.
sents.zh: CUDA 后端可能比 Vulkan 更快或更慢，具体取决于 GPU 驱动，差异通常在几个百分点以内。

sents.en: Vulkan backend can be slightly more VRAM efficient in some cases.
sents.zh: 在某些情况下，Vulkan 后端的显存效率可能略高一些。

paragraphs.en: Make sure you have Vulkan SDK installed. On macOS, MoltenVK is automatically fetched by CMake. Clone the repository and run the commands:
paragraphs.zh: 请确保已安装 Vulkan SDK。 在 macOS 上，CMake 会自动获取 MoltenVK。 克隆该仓库并运行以下命令：

sents.en: Make sure you have Vulkan SDK installed.
sents.zh: 请确保已安装 Vulkan SDK。

sents.en: On macOS, MoltenVK is automatically fetched by CMake.
sents.zh: 在 macOS 上，CMake 会自动获取 MoltenVK。

sents.en: Clone the repository and run the commands:
sents.zh: 克隆该仓库并运行以下命令：

paragraphs.en: cd spirula-studio\ .\build_develop.bat -DSS_BACKEND=vulkan -DSS_ENABLE_PATENTED=ON If it builds successfully, you get build_vulkan\spirula.exe .
paragraphs.zh:
```
cd spirula-studio
.\build_develop.bat -DSS_BACKEND=vulkan -DSS_ENABLE_PATENTED=ON
```
如果构建成功，你将得到 `build_vulkan\spirula.exe`。

paragraphs.en: cd spirula-studio\ cmake -G Ninja -B build_vulkan -DCMAKE_BUILD_TYPE=Release -DSS_BACKEND=vulkan -DSS_ENABLE_PATENTED=ON -DCMAKE_MAKE_PROGRAM=Ninja cmake --build build_vulkan -j Pass -DCMAKE_C_COMPILER and -DCMAKE_CXX_COMPILER to the first cmake command if needed.
paragraphs.zh:
cd spirula-studio
cmake -G Ninja -B build_vulkan -DCMAKE_BUILD_TYPE=Release -DSS_BACKEND=vulkan -DSS_ENABLE_PATENTED=ON -DCMAKE_MAKE_PROGRAM=Ninja
cmake --build build_vulkan -j

如有需要，可在第一条 cmake 命令中传入 -DCMAKE_C_COMPILER 和 -DCMAKE_CXX_COMPILER。

paragraphs.en: If it builds successfully, you get build_vulkan\spirula.exe .
paragraphs.zh: 如果构建成功，你会得到 build_vulkan\spirula.exe。

paragraphs.en: cd spirula-studio/ bash build_develop.bash -DSS_BACKEND=vulkan -DSS_ENABLE_PATENTED=ON If it builds successfully, you get build_vulkan/spirula binary.
paragraphs.zh: cd spirula-studio/ bash build_develop.bash -DSS_BACKEND=vulkan -DSS_ENABLE_PATENTED=ON 如果构建成功，你将得到 build_vulkan/spirula 二进制文件。

paragraphs.en: cd spirula-studio/ bash build_develop.bash -DSS_BACKEND=vulkan -DSS_ENABLE_PATENTED=ON cmake --build build --target macos_app cmake --build build --target macos_dmg macOS has only the one backend, so it builds into build/ rather than into a per-backend tree. If it builds successfully, you get build/spirula binary similar to Linux. Additionally, it wraps that binary in a double-clickable build/Spirula Studio.app , as well as disk image build/Spirula Studio.dmg . MoltenVK is statically linked by default and will run on a Mac without dependency installed.
paragraphs.zh: cd spirula-studio/ bash build_develop.bash -DSS_BACKEND=vulkan -DSS_ENABLE_PATENTED=ON cmake --build build --target macos_app cmake --build build --target macos_dmg macOS 只有这一个后端，因此它构建到 build/ 中，而不是按后端划分的目录树。 如果构建成功，你会得到与 Linux 类似的 build/spirula 二进制文件。 此外，它还会把该二进制文件封装成可双击打开的 build/Spirula Studio.app，以及磁盘映像 build/Spirula Studio.dmg。 MoltenVK 默认以静态方式链接，无需安装任何依赖即可在 Mac 上运行。

sents.en: cd spirula-studio/ bash build_develop.bash -DSS_BACKEND=vulkan -DSS_ENABLE_PATENTED=ON cmake --build build --target macos_app cmake --build build --target macos_dmg macOS has only the one backend, so it builds into build/ rather than into a per-backend tree.
sents.zh: cd spirula-studio/ bash build_develop.bash -DSS_BACKEND=vulkan -DSS_ENABLE_PATENTED=ON cmake --build build --target macos_app cmake --build build --target macos_dmg macOS 只有这一个后端，因此它构建到 build/ 中，而不是按后端划分的目录树。

sents.en: If it builds successfully, you get build/spirula binary similar to Linux.
sents.zh: 如果构建成功，你会得到与 Linux 类似的 build/spirula 二进制文件。

sents.en: Additionally, it wraps that binary in a double-clickable build/Spirula Studio.app , as well as disk image build/Spirula Studio.dmg .
sents.zh: 此外，它还会把该二进制文件封装成可双击打开的 build/Spirula Studio.app，以及磁盘映像 build/Spirula Studio.dmg。

sents.en: MoltenVK is statically linked by default and will run on a Mac without dependency installed.
sents.zh: MoltenVK 默认以静态方式链接，无需安装任何依赖即可在 Mac 上运行。

paragraphs.en: -DSS_ENABLE_PATENTED=ON enables decoding video on the GPU instead of shelling out to ffmpeg (about 15x faster frame extraction, and without need to install ffmpeg). However, AVC/HEVC bitstream parsers carry third-party patent exposure. If you turn this on, you are responsible for ensuring compliance with local patent laws regarding AVC/HEVC playback.
paragraphs.zh: -DSS_ENABLE_PATENTED=ON 启用直接在 GPU 上解码视频，而不用调用 ffmpeg（帧提取速度快约 15 倍，且无需安装 ffmpeg）。 然而，AVC/HEVC 码流解析器存在第三方专利风险。 如果你开启此选项，你需要自行确保遵守当地关于 AVC/HEVC 播放的专利法律。

paragraphs.en: Masking needs a SAM checkpoint, which the GUI downloads on first use and caches. The checkpoints are Meta's models under Meta's licenses – SAM 2.1 is Apache-2.0, SAM 3 is under Meta's own, non-standard license. They are never bundled, and the GUI shows the terms before fetching anything. On the command line, point --model at a file you downloaded yourself.
paragraphs.zh: 掩码功能需要一个 SAM 检查点，图形界面会在首次使用时下载并缓存它。 这些检查点是 Meta 在 Meta 许可证下发布的模型——SAM 2.1 采用 Apache-2.0 许可证，SAM 3 则采用 Meta 自有的非标准许可证。 它们从不被打包捆绑，图形界面会在获取任何内容之前展示相关条款。 在命令行中，将 --model 指向你自行下载的文件。

paragraphs.en: You can find some professional-quality splats trained by Spirula Studio from Megascapes Library and their SuperSplat page .

paragraphs.en: Spirula Studio (formerly spirulae-splat) is named after the now-inactive project spirulae , which was named after the deep-ocean cephalopod mollusk .
paragraphs.zh: Spirula Studio（原名 spirulae-splat）得名于现已停止维护的项目 spirulae，而 spirulae 则以深海头足类软体动物（旋壳乌贼）命名。

paragraphs.en: Spirula Studio is maintained almost entirely by one person. Issues and PRs welcome – I sometimes respond late, but rest assured that I do review them all.
paragraphs.zh: Spirula Studio 几乎完全由一个人维护。 欢迎提交 Issue 和 PR——我有时回复较晚，但请放心，我一定会全部审阅。
